newsitem.title: USA: BIOLASE begins product shipments in Germany.
newsitem.headline: BIOLASE begins product shipments in Germany.

text.p: BIOLASE Technology Inc said it has begun shipping its Millennium dental system to Orbis High Tech GmbH for distribution in Germany.

Millennium uses a laser to rapidly energize and transform atomized water droplets into high-speed water particles that cut hard and soft tissues. The system provides an alternative to traditional dental drills and surgical scalpels.
Orbis' minimum purchase commitment is valued at over $12 million over three years.
BIOLASE is seeking FDA approval to sell Millennium in the United States for dentistry, dermatology and cosmetic surgery.
